entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-08-12
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Query shaper assumes primitive collections are stored as JSON strings, breaking providers with native collection support (11.0 preview 7 regression) #38796

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix IsTableExcludedFromMigrations default for entity splitting. #38802
  • [release/9.0]: Bump SQLite3MC.PCLRaw.bundle from 2.3.5 to 2.4.0 #38801
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/9.0]: Bump OpenTelemetry.Exporter.InMemory from 1.16.0 to 1.17.0 #38800
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/9.0]: Bump Microsoft.Azure.Cosmos from 3.62.0 to 3.62.1 #38799
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/9.0]: Bump Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore from 8.0.29 to 8.0.30 #38798
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/9.0]: Bump Grpc.AspNetCore from 2.80.0 to 2.83.0 #38797
    area-infrastructure
  • Generate TimestampAttribute when scaffolding row version properties #38795
    community-contribution, 12.0.0
  • Enable nullability in shared test sources #38792
  • Enable nullability in shared specification tests #38791

Merged

  • Enable nullability in relational and design tests #38790
  • Enable nullability in provider tests #38789
  • Enable nullability in benchmarks and core tests #38788

Updated

  • Fix ValuesExpression pruning dropping outer columns referenced from VALUES cells #38779
    community-contribution, 12.0.0
  • Scaffolding fails for a self-referencing many-to-many join table when both FKs yield the same navigation name #38787
    community-contribution, 12.0.0
  • Preserve identifiers across to-one joins #38771
    community-contribution
